response.sql: WITH bucket_counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), bucket_shares AS (SELECT bucket_count, bucket_count::numeric / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () AS share FROM bucket_counts), compared AS (SELECT bucket_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS all_bucket_average FROM bucket_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bucket_count) FILTER (WHERE share > all_bucket_average), 0) AS total_count, AVG(share) FILTER (WHERE share > all_bucket_average) AS average_share, AVG(share - all_bucket_average) FILTER (WHERE share > all_bucket_average) AS average_excess FROM compared;
